newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Eight hurt in Hebron, none killed-security chief.
newsitem.headline: Eight hurt in Hebron, none killed-security chief.

text.p: An Israeli soldier shot and wounded eight Palestinians but killed none in the West Bank town of Hebron on Wednesday, the chief of Palestinian security in the West Bank said.

"There are eight wounded. One was in critical condition and was sent to Hadassah hospital. We thought he died but he didn't. He is in bad condition," said Jibril Rajoub, who earlier told Israeli army radio that one was killed and 10 wounded.
